def equation(eps, T, params):

    L = np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*T**3) + (p[4]+p[5]*T+p[6]*T**2)*L + (p[7]+p[8]*T)/eps + p[9]*T/eps**2
